notes: Stories created for EVAL-WEIGHTS covering schema, logic, API/UI, integration, and tests.

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.title: Define Weighting Schema and Persistence Contract
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.description: Define data model for user-adjustable weights across quality measures, including defaults, bounds, and persistence format for reuse across sessions.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S1.evidence: GAP: No weighting schema or persistence model exists

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.title: Implement Weighted Scoring Logic
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.description: Extend scoring calculation to apply user-defined weights to individual measures and recompute composite scores deterministically.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S2.evidence: GAP: Existing scoring engines do not support dynamic weighting

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.title: Expose Weight Adjustment API and UI Controls
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.description: Create backend endpoints and frontend controls to allow users to adjust weights (e.g., sliders or inputs) and trigger score recalculation.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S3.evidence: GAP: No API or UI exists for weight adjustment

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.title: Integrate Weighting into Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S4.description: Integrate weighting inputs into evaluate_care_facade so both provider and clinical trial evaluations return recalculated scores based on user preferences.

EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.title: Weighting Logic Unit and Integration Tests
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.description: Create unit tests for weighting calculations and integration tests validating end-to-end score changes when weights are adjusted.
EVAL-WEIGHTS-S5.evidence: GAP: No existing tests for weighting behavior
